[CR CR1435 for 38.423] Reason for change: The agreed R3-240947 (38.423 CR1226r1) implemented onto TS 38.423 v18.1.0 wrongly placed the S-CPAC Request IE description of the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message in 8.3.4.3 “Unsuccessful Operation”. Summary of change: Moved the description into the right place of 8.3.4.2 “Successful Operation”. Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release). This CR only has an impact on Rel-18 Intra-SN S-CPAC. Consequences if not approved: The S-CPAC Request IE description is not aligned with the procedural intention.

[4] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.473, sim=0.6076)
[CR CR1039r1 for 38.473] Reason for change: At RAN3 #117, a CR was agreed where two of the report characteristics were renamed in the Semantics description (R3-224950). However, they were forgotten in the procedural text. Summary of change: The names in the procedural text are corrected to match the new names of the reporting characteristics. Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): The impact can be considered isolated because the change only clarifies names used in an IE. Consequences if not approved: Inconsistency between the semantics description and the procedural text remains.

[5] (ran3_cr_chunks 37.483, sim=0.6067)
[CR CR0089r1 for 37.483] Reason for change: In R3-204502, the resource status report related procedures were introduced, but the Assigned Criticality of the Registration Request IE and Reporting Periodicity IE were not aligned in tabular and asn.1. Considering of the functionality, and aligned with XnAP and F1AP, it is better to use criticality reject for the Registration Request IE, and use criticality ignore for the Reporting Periodicity IE. It is also noticed that the Report Characteristics IE was defined as Size 32 in the tabular but 36 in the asn.1. Although in XnAP and F1AP the similar IE is defined as size 32, considering of backward compatibility, it is better to change the tabular to align with asn.1. Summary of change: In the tabular, change the Assigned Criticality of the Regist

[6] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.470, sim=0.6066)
[CR CR0119r3 for 38.470] Reason for change: The WID on NR Timing Resiliency and URLLC enhancements was approved in RP-230754. This CR is to specify the necessary functions and procedures to support the objectives. Summary of change: Support the Timing Synchronisation Status Reporting function and procedures. Consequences if not approved: Not support of the NR Timing Resiliency and URLLC enhancements.

Justification captured from [1]: In RAN3 #111e online meeing, the Tdoc R3-211310 was agreed, which is about stage-3 CR on transmission stop for Rel-16 DAPS handover. All the changes in R3-211310 have been merged correctly in TS38.473 V16.5.0, except, in tabular, the new IE Transmission Stop Indicator is added in DRB to Be Setup List IE in UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message by mistake. It should be added in DRB to Be Modified List IE in UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message according to the agreed CR. Namely, this is to fix the CR implementation error of an IE that was correctly implemented onto ASN.1 but wrongly placed in the tabular (good catch!). ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

[10] (ran3_tdoc_chunks R3-237751, sim=0.5684)
For the MC Bearer Context To Modify Required IE in MC BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUIRED message, the assigned criticality is “reject” in tabular while it is “ignore” in ASN.1. The proposal here is to Change the assigned criticality of the MCBearerContextToModifyRequired IE from ”ignore” to “reject” in ASN.1 Conclusion: Agree the change in the CR while update the cover page of the CR.
